name: 색상 일관성 벡터
description: Differentiates spatially coherent vs. incoherent color 분포. AI images tend to have unnaturally high color 일관성 in regions.
mechanism: Classifies each pixel as coherent or incoherent based on connected component membership relative to region size 임계값. Computes ratio 사이의 coherent and incoherent pixels per color bin.
parameters: Color quantization: 64 bins, Coherence 임계값: 25 pixels, Connected components: 4-connectivity
source: Pass, G. et al. (1996) — Histogram Refinement for Content-Based Image Retrieval, ACM MM Workshop
useCase: Detecting overly uniform color regions in AI 생성 images

references.title: Pass, G. et al. (1996). Histogram Refinement for Content-Based Image Retrieval. ACM Multimedia Workshop.

strengths:
• Captures spatial color relationships
• Goes beyond simple 히스토그램
• Fast connected component 분석
• Complementary color signal
limitations:
• Lower 정확도 for complex scenes
• Sensitive to quantization parameters
• Limited without spatial context
• AI can produce diverse color regions
